body:
The Chart view now opens with Rozliczenie, in 5199605 and running in the existing HTTPS app. A counter's person is the last word of its name; a person's value is total times rate over their rated counters in the range; whoever has the lower value pays the difference. Both rules are the owner's answers from 2026-10-07. On a phone every summary card now shares one layout.

Unit tests and the Chromium and WebKit charts suites pass, with motion, responsive and localization in Chromium; the full gate was not run. Rates stay browser-local, so the amount appears once rates are entered on that device. Acceptance of the rule's wording and the layout is the owner's. Evidence: progress/2026-10-07-chart-settlement.md.

metadata.summary: Chart view opens with who owes whom
